reviews.title: Fast, Snappy with Excellent Battery Life
reviews.body:
TLDR:  For those fully into the Google ecosystem.  For all others, not sure how these really fit in. 

PROS
Excellent battery life 
Premium build quality 
Sharp, vibrant OLED display 
Excellent thermals 
Nearly seamless setup with an Android phone 

CONS 
Expensive 
An unusual and somewhat ambitious
reviews.excerpt: The Googlebook is unquestionably more capable than any Chromebook I've used before.

reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.body:
So this new laptop from Google is actually really solid, and a lot of people will love it with one condition. But first. 

Hardware: This laptop feels great on the exterior, and the screen is beautiful. The keyboard is really nice to type on with extended use, no fatigue should occur for most users.
reviews.excerpt: The software is where it gets interesting, because while it’s the new GoogleBook it still just feels like my other chromebook most times.

reviews.title: Gorgeous & fast, but I chose Lenovo instead
reviews.body:
